raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Network Automation Engineer with 4.5 years of experience at Cisco Systems, specialising in large-scale network fabric automation, operational tooling, and distributed system deployments. Strong hands-on expertise with Layer 2-3 protocols (BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, SDA) at an operational and validation level, and with Layer 7 API integrations (Cisco Catalyst Center REST APIs). Experienced in Python-based framework development, CI/CD pipeline engineering, and infrastructure-as-code. Industry presenter at Cisco Live (2x) and COMSNETS.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Consulting Engineer | Cisco Systems India Pvt. Ltd.
Aug 2021 – Present
Architected and led development of a configuration automation platform for BGP EVPN-VXLAN fabrics using Python, Ansible, Jinja2, and NetBox, reducing deployment effort by 80% across large-scale enterprise environments.
Developed an in-house Python-based vendor-agnostic network state analysis framework for gathering, parsing, and validating device state across heterogeneous environments, accelerating network design and redesign cycles by 80%.
Designed and deployed GitLab CI/CD pipelines with Terraform for automated, change-driven network provisioning, enabling repeatable infrastructure-as-code workflows aligned with DevOps and Agile practices.
Engineered integrations with Cisco Catalyst Center REST APIs and SDA assurance APIs (Layer 4-7), improving operational visibility, monitoring, and automated troubleshooting across distributed network fabrics.
Delivered on-site deployments for large-scale distributed environments including cruise ship networks, applying automated validation, state checks, and real-time troubleshooting under mission-critical conditions.
Built RAG and LLM-powered internal chatbots (LangChain, LlamaIndex, pydantic-ai) to accelerate knowledge retrieval and internal engineering workflows.
Speaker and hands-on-lab host at Cisco Live (2x) and COMSNETS, presenting on SDA automation, Catalyst Center APIs, and zero-touch provisioning to senior technical audiences.
Technical Undergraduate Intern | Cisco Systems India Pvt. Ltd.
Jan 2021 – Jun 2021 • Designed a Python-based tool to detect and audit feature configurations across switch inventories,
enabling automated compliance checks at scale.
